# Sensitive-text guard positives. Format: class	text. Every value is synthetic.
# Each line carries exactly one sensitive item of the tagged class.
# Classes: ssn, card, dob, mrn, phone, personal_email, secret.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored by the corpus test.
# The mask character U+00A6 (broken bar) is removed by the test loader. Secret lines carry it
# inside each key so GitHub push protection does not mistake these invented tokens for real ones.
